Name: Isekai Bonds - Six Heroines Character Pack OnePiece
Author: Alex3108
Description:
[center][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=6][color=#d7a743][b]ISEKAI BONDS[/b][/color][/size]
[size=5][color=#9c75d6][b]ONE PIECE PACK[/b][/color][/size]

[i]An unofficial fan-made expansion inspired by One Piece[/i]

[color=#d7a743]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[b]6 HEROINES • 24 DEVIL FRUITS • 30 CONTRACTS • BOND CARDS[/b][/color]
[/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]

[size=5][color=#d7a743][b]DESCRIPTION[/b][/color][/size]

[b]Isekai Bonds – One Piece Pack[/b] is an unofficial, fan-made gameplay expansion for [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b], inspired by the world, characters, and Devil Fruits of [i]One Piece[/i].

Discover unidentified Devil Fruits, analyze their powers, develop their mastery, unlock awakened abilities, and choose the fruit that best suits your current objective.

Build relationships with six heroines, complete their unique contracts, activate their Bond Cards, and combine multiple characters to unlock special crew synergies.[/color]

[i]From the author: The last two packs, this one and Dragon Ball, I think have the best concept of my mods. I spent quite a bit of time on them despite using AI, and now I'll take a break from creating packs to see if these ones pose any problems. I'll also play with them myself. [/i]

[quote][color=#D4D4D8]
This is not only a portrait pack.

The One Piece Pack adds a complete progression system designed to affect combat, farming, exploration, resource gathering, character development, and long-term gameplay.[/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Included heroines:[/b][/color]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Boa Hancock[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Nami[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Nico Robin[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Perona[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tashigi[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Yamato[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Each heroine has her own gameplay role, contract rewards, Bond Card bonuses, preferred Devil Fruit categories, and progression path.

[color=#d7a743]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]


[size=5][color=#d7a743][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[b]1.[/b] Install the required versions of:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Stardew Valley[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]All mandatory dependencies listed on the Isekai Bonds mod page[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]2.[/b] Download and extract the One Piece Pack archive.

[b]3.[/b] Copy the included folder:[/color]


[code]
ValleyBonds.IsekaiBonds[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] directory.

When Windows asks what to do, choose to [b]merge the folders[/b] with your existing Isekai Bonds installation.[/color]


[quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[color=#d9534f][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/color]

Do not delete or completely replace your original ValleyBonds.IsekaiBonds folder.

The One Piece character pack and setting module must be merged into the already installed base mod.[/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]4.[/b] Copy the following folder into [b]Mods[/b] as a separate SMAPI mod:[/color]


[code]
ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]5.[/b] Your installation should look similar to this:[/color]


[code]
Stardew Valley
└─ Mods
  ├─ ValleyBonds.IsekaiBonds
  │  ├─ character_packs
  │  │  └─ OnePiecePack
  │  └─ setting_modules
  │    └─ OnePiece
  │
  └─ ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework
      ├─ ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework.dll
      └─ manifest.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]6.[/b] Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[b]7.[/b] Check the SMAPI console and confirm that the One Piece character pack and One Piece Framework loaded successfully.

When updating, merge the new files into the existing folders. Existing configuration and save progress should remain intact unless manually deleted.

[color=#d7a743]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]


[size=5][color=#d7a743][b]MAIN FEATURES[/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]SIX DISTINCT HEROINES[/b][/color][/size]

Every heroine provides a different gameplay style.[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] [b]Nami[/b] — money, exploration, fruit discovery, and research expeditions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Nico Robin[/b] — Devil Fruit knowledge, research, and mastery progression.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Boa Hancock[/b] — social, support, and utility-based Devil Fruits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Perona[/b] — defensive, supernatural, and charge-saving abilities.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Tashigi[/b] — combat-focused fruits, damage bonuses, and battle training.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Yamato[/b] — Zoan fruits, mastery growth, and improved charge recovery.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]24 PLAYABLE DEVIL FRUITS[/b][/color][/size]

Find unidentified Devil Fruits through contracts and rare drops, then use the Fruit Analyzer to reveal their identities.

Devil Fruit abilities include:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Area damage[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Teleportation and movement[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Healing and protection[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Crop watering[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Resource gathering[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Object clearing[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enemy control[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Item attraction[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Energy restoration[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Farming utility[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Temporary speed bonuses[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Defensive effects[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Every fruit has its own:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Name and artwork[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Rarity and category[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ability description[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Visual animation[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Charge system[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mastery progression[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Awakened form[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]

[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]FRUIT ANALYZER MACHINE[/b][/color][/size]

The Fruit Analyzer is the central device of the pack.

Use it to:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Analyze unidentified Devil Fruits[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Browse the discovered-fruit album[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Read complete ability descriptions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Check remaining charges[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]View mastery and awakening progress[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select your active Devil Fruit[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Configure keyboard, mouse, and controller controls[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The complete fruit management interface is accessed through the machine, ensuring that crafting and placing it remains meaningful.


[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]CHARGES, MASTERY, AND AWAKENING[/b][/color][/size]

Devil Fruit abilities consume charges.

Charges can be recovered through:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Duplicate Devil Fruits[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Daily recovery[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Heroine contracts[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Bond Card effects[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Crew synergies[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Special character bonuses[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Using and analyzing fruits increases their mastery.

At maximum mastery, a fruit awakens and receives improved damage, radius, duration, utility, protection, movement, farming, or resource effects depending on its role.


[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]BOND CARDS AND CREW SYNERGIES[/b][/color][/size]

Active One Piece Bond Cards provide stackable gameplay bonuses.

Specific heroine combinations also unlock special crew synergies:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] [b]Nami + Robin — Research Expedition[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Boa + Perona — Royal Darkness[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Tashigi + Yamato — Vanguard Oath[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
These combinations encourage different character and Devil Fruit builds instead of creating one universally superior setup.


[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]SECRET PORTRAIT STAGES[/b][/color][/size]

Each heroine includes an additional secret portrait stage that can be permanently unlocked through gameplay progression.

Secret portraits require meaningful investment in:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Heroine relationship progression[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Active Bond Cards[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Devil Fruit discovery[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Signature contracts[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Mature portraits respect the corresponding Isekai Bonds content settings and can be disabled.


[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]KEYBOARD AND CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/b][/color][/size]

The Devil Fruit ability button can be changed directly through the Fruit Analyzer settings menu.

Separate bindings are supported for:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Keyboard and mouse[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Gamepad[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[color=#d7a743]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]


[size=5][color=#d7a743][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]REQUIRED[/b][/color][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds 0.11.12 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]All mandatory dependencies listed on the Isekai Bonds mod page[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The included ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
The included framework must be installed as a separate SMAPI mod folder.


[size=4][color=#9c75d6][b]NOT REQUIRED[/b][/color][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] External Setting Bridge[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A new save file[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher specifically for this pack, unless required by another installed mod[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
The pack can be added to an existing save.[/color]


[quote][color=#D4D4D8]
Backing up your save before installing or updating large gameplay mods is always recommended.[/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[color=#d9534f][b]MATURE CONTENT NOTICE[/b][/color]

This pack contains optional mature portrait content.

Please check the Files section and the selected Nexus content tags before downloading.

[size=4][color=#d7a743][b]О МОДЕ[/b][/color][/size]

[b]Isekai Bonds — One Piece Pack[/b] — это полноценное игровое дополнение для [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b].

Пак добавляет шесть героинь, контракты, Bond Card-бонусы, командные синергии и систему Дьявольских плодов с зарядами, мастерством и пробуждением.

Это не просто набор портретов: способности плодов влияют на сражения, исследование мира, фермерство, передвижение и сбор ресурсов.

[b]Героини:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Боа Хэнкок[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Нами[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Нико Робин[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Перона[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ташиги[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ямато[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]

[size=4][color=#d7a743][b]ОСНОВНЫЕ ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ[/b][/color][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]6 героинь[/b] с разными стилями развития и бонусами.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]30 контрактов[/b] — по пять заданий для каждой героини.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]24 Дьявольских плода[/b] с уникальными способностями и анимациями.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Система зарядов, мастерства и пробуждения плодов.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Отдельная машина-анализатор для исследования неизвестных плодов.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Альбом открытых плодов и выбор активной способности.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Настраиваемое управление для клавиатуры, мыши и геймпада.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Складывающиеся эффекты Bond Card.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Особые синергии между парами героинь.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Секретные стадии портретов, открываемые через игровой прогресс.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][color=#d7a743][b]УСТАНОВКА[/b][/color][/size]

[b]1.[/b] Установите [b]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds[/b] и все его обязательные зависимости.

[b]2.[/b] Скопируйте папку:[/color]


[code]
ValleyBonds.IsekaiBonds[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
в папку [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b].

При появлении запроса выберите [b]объединение папок[/b].[/color]


[quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[color=#d9534f][b]Важно:[/b][/color]

Не удаляйте и не заменяйте целиком основной мод ValleyBonds.IsekaiBonds. Папку из архива нужно объединить с уже установленной папкой мода.[/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]3.[/b] Скопируйте папку:[/color]


[code]
ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
в [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] как отдельный SMAPI-мод.

[b]4.[/b] Запустите игру через SMAPI.


[size=4][color=#d7a743][b]ТРЕБОВАНИЯ[/b][/color][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 или новее[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.5.2 или новее[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds 0.11.12 или новее[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Все обязательные зависимости Isekai Bonds[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]ValleyBonds.OnePieceFramework из архива[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Новая игра не требуется — пак можно добавить в существующее сохранение.

Перед установкой или обновлением рекомендуется сделать резервную копию сохранения.
